Changing a setup creates a new 8-second experiment. A bump begins at 1 s; sine amplitude is measured from zero.

Model assumptions

Illustrative parameters. A vertical guide holds a lumped wheel and load. The tyre uses a clipped spring/damper surrogate. No rolling, rider, fork, tread or pressure model yet.

Dashed circle: unloaded radius. The platen overlaps that outline by the model's compression; tyre shape is not a carcass simulation.

RK4 at 0.5 ms. Replay samples at 5 ms. Contact event times are sampled. Compression above 35% of radius invalidates a run.
